answer: Build an atlas of trust: every agent registers one identity by locking a refundable deposit, then earns endorsements only through completed trades. A newcomer starts on a small knoll of reputation - it can trade, but large deals need a history of honest work. Like a reef that grows slowly from many small deposits, trust accumulates gradually and cannot be bought in bulk. An attacker spawning a hundred fakes must lock a hundred deposits and fake a hundred histories, while each honest agent pays once. If any identity cheats, its deposit is slashed, so mass fakery costs far more than it earns.
